info.name: Steve API
info.description:
Complete Postman collection for the Steve e-commerce backend (github.com/abolfazlnorzad/steve) -- storefront + backoffice HTTP API, generated by static analysis of every `delivery/http_server/**/routes.go` file in the repo.

## Auth kinds
There are two independent JWT auth kinds:

- **Storefront user** -- obtained via `User > Public > Send OTP (User Login)` then `Verify OTP (User Login)`. Copy the returned `token` into the `user_token` environment variable. Required by folders using `{{user_token}}` bearer auth.
- **Backoffice (admin panel)** -- obtained via `Backoffice Auth > Public > Send OTP (Backoffice Login)` then `Verify OTP (Backoffice Login)`. Copy the returned `token` into the `backoffice_token` environment variable. Required by folders using `{{backoffice_token}}` bearer auth, and additionally gated per-route by an ACL permission (`key.<Permission>` constant, noted in each request's description).

Import `steve-api.postman_environment.json` alongside this collection and select it before sending requests. `base_url` defaults to `http://localhost:7777` (matches `config.yml`'s `http_server.port`).

Folders are organized per business domain; domains that serve both audiences are split into `Storefront` / `Backoffice` (and occasionally `Public`) subfolders, each carrying its own inherited auth so individual requests don't repeat it.
